svg.aria-label: Newer cohorts retain better: month-3 logo retention improved from 50% to 64% through 2025
svg.desc: Cohort retention triangle, 12 cohorts by 12 periods since start. Retention = active / cohort base (period 0). Period 0 is 100% by construction. The oldest cohort reaches 21.3% at M11; the newest reaches 100% at M0. 66 cells are blank because those cohorts have not reached that period. Bases: 1200 for the oldest cohort, 1900 for the newest.
